note: Official support contact routes, US, taken only from each service's own help pages (2026-10-31). Phone numbers only where the service publishes one. Hulu and NYT not yet confirmed.

netflix.how: No published phone number. Call or chat from the Netflix app: open Help, then tap Call or Chat.

spotify.how: No phone support. Send a message to Spotify customer service.

amazon_prime.how: Sign in and use Amazon's Help & Contact Us page.

youtube_premium.how: Sign in, then chat or request a call from YouTube's paid products support page.

disney_plus.how: Use Contact Us in the Disney+ Help Center.

hbo_max.how: Use Contact us in the HBO Max Help Center, or message @hbomaxhelp on X.

apple_music.how: Call Apple Support, chat in the Messages app, or start online.

icloud.how: Call Apple Support, chat in the Messages app, or start online.

peacock.how: No phone number. Sign in, then use Get in Touch for live chat (9 AM to 1 AM ET) or email.

paramount_plus.how: Use Contact Us in the Paramount+ Help Center.

google_one.how: Members can chat, call or email Google One support. In the app: Menu, Help, then Contact us.

chatgpt.how: Get help through the OpenAI Help Center.

claude.how: No phone support. In Claude, open Get help from the account menu to message support.

m365.how: Choose Personal & family accounts, then Get Home support for live chat with a Microsoft specialist.

xbox_game_pass.how: Sign in and use Contact us on Xbox Support.

playstation_plus.how: Look up your issue first. PlayStation Support then shows the right way to contact them.

planet_fitness.how: Billing and membership questions go to your home club. If it's closed, Member Services helps on weekdays.

doordash_dashpass.how: Use Contact Support in the DoorDash Help Center or app.

uber_one.how: Report membership or billing problems from Uber's Uber One help page.

walmart_plus.how: Chat with Walmart from the Walmart.com help page.

costco.how: See Costco's Contact Us page for membership phone and live chat options.

audible.how: Customer service is open 24/7. Use Audible's Contact Us page and pick your issue.
